title: Speech-DRAME: A Framework for Human-Aligned Benchmarks in Speech Role-Play
abstract: arXiv:2511.01261v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Evaluating spoken role-play requires judging not only linguistic content but also prosody, emotional expression, character embodiment, and contextual fit. Existing automatic evaluation methods often collapse these aspects into coarse scores and are evaluated primarily on synthesized speech. We introduce Speech-DRAME, a framework comprising Speech-DRAME-EvalBench, a bilingual, human-annotated benchmark with contrastive role-, context-, and delivery-mismatch conditions, and DRAME-Eval, a fine-tuned audio-language evaluator. The benchmark supports two complementary protocols: top-down archetype evaluation and bottom-up realism evaluation, with predominantly synthesized benchmark-distribution data and a held-out stress test consisting entirely of authentic human acting. translated_title: Speech-DRAME：面向语音角色扮演的人类对齐基准测试框架
translated_abstract: 评估口语化角色扮演不仅需要判断语言内容，还需要评估韵律、情感表达、角色体现以及情境契合度。现有的自动评估方法往往将这些方面压缩为粗略的分数，且主要在合成语音上进行评估。我们提出了Speech-DRAME，该框架包含两个部分：Speech-DRAME-EvalBench——一个双语、经人工标注的基准，其中设计了角色错配、情境错配和表达方式错配的对比条件；以及DRAME-Eval——一个经过微调的音频语言评估器。该基准支持两种互补的评估协议：自上而下的原型评估和自下而上的真实感评估，其基准分布数据主要由合成数据构成，并包含一个完全由真实人类表演组成的留出压力测试集。在基准分布数据集上，DRAME-Eval在原型评估中取得了0.629的合并皮尔逊相关系数，在真实感评估中取得了0.602的合并皮尔逊相关系数，显著优于……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了包含双语人工标注基准Speech-DRAME-EvalBench与微调音频语言评估器DRAME-Eval的Speech-DRAME框架，使语音角色扮演的自动评估与人类判断高度一致。
en_tdlr: Speech-DRAME introduces a bilingual, human-annotated benchmark (Speech-DRAME-EvalBench) and a fine-tuned audio-language evaluator (DRAME-Eval) that aligns automatic spoken role-play evaluation with human judgments.
